intendedObjective: Update the cabin key safe code.
acceptableEditScope: Change only the code once supplied; preserve all other directions and precautions.
stableFactsAndClaims: Drive slowly beyond the cattle grid; use the apple-tree passing place rather than the soft verge; park by the woodpile and leave the smaller gate clear.
The safe is beside the porch; close it and scramble digits after use. Lift the damp-weather front-door handle before turning the key; the kitchen spare opens only the back door.

The heater switch is outside the bathroom and needs about half an hour. Cloudiness should clear after standing; persistent cloudiness or unusual smell requires a call before use. Bottled water is in the pantry.
Use small firewood, keep the screen in place, and close the stove door before leaving the room. August chimney sweeping does not authorize unattended burning; keep the hall smoke alarm on.
On departure, strip beds into the basket without washing, empty the bin, close windows, switch off the heater, return the key, and message upon reaching the paved road.
authorizedFactualChanges: Replace the existing code 6148 with a new code, but no replacement is supplied.
requiredForm: Personal cabin arrival and departure notes.
voiceConstraints: Friendly, detailed practical guidance with intact precautions.
